blurb: Bergen County Equestrian Center offers horseback riding lessons at three skill tiers, equine-assisted therapy programs, pony ride birthday parties, corporate events, and horse boarding. Lessons cover basics to advanced riding and jumping skills. The facility includes indoor and outdoor rings, tack rooms, and a heated lounge.
